work_completed: Created Go module go/nlt-toi (module github.com/NeuroLift-Technologies/nlt-toi/go/nlt-toi) implementing RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization, mirroring the merged Rust crate crates/nlt-toi and the TS/Python references.

Implemented FormatNumber — ECMA-262 Number::toString (6.1.6.1.20) on top of strconv shortest digits: strconv 'e' shortest output decomposed into significant digits + decimal exponent, then ECMAScript decimal/exponent selection rules (42, 0.000001, 1e+21 with plus sign, 10000000 for 1e7).

CanonicalizeJCS round-trips input through encoding/json with json.Decoder.UseNumber so integer tokens pass through verbatim (preserving precision beyond 2^53, e.g. 9007199254740993 and 30-digit integers) while float tokens go through FormatNumber; -0.0 renders as 0.
UTF-16BE key sorting per RFC 8785 §3.2.3 (utf16.Encode into big-endian byte sequences) with ECMAScript-compatible string escaping (HTML escaping disabled, matching JSON.stringify).
Ported ToiDocument/ToiSignature/ToiTier, TOI constants, and TierRank to types.go; CanonicalizeToBytes and ContentHash (SHA-256 hex) for receipts.

Added 19 Go tests incl. 10 cross-runtime parity vectors ported verbatim from the Rust cross_runtime_parity module (same as TS packages/toi/test/canonicalize.test.ts and Python tests/test_canonicalize.py) — all green (go test).
Cross-runtime confirmation: Rust crate cargo test 17 passed; Python reference python3 -m pytest tests/test_canonicalize.py 10 passed.
Updated CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased → Added) and docs/active-threads.md (Rust thread resolved, new NLT-TOI-GO-PORT thread).
work_in_progress: Go PR open for review/merge on GitHub (branch go/nlt-toi-jcs-canonicalizer).
decisions_made: Use strconv.FormatFloat(n, 'e', -1, 64) shortest scientific form as the digit source (Go's 'g' format is not JCS-conformant: renders 1e-06, 1e+07). Decompose into digits + decimal exponent and apply the same ECMA-262 selection rules as the Rust/Python references.

Use json.Decoder.UseNumber() during normalization so integer tokens remain integer-typed and pass through un-parsed, preserving precision beyond 2^53 — mirrors the Rust post_process_numbers integer pass-through.
Go package name nlt_toi (directory go/nlt-toi) following the Rust crates/nlt-toi placement convention.
